title: Rivian Partners With EnergyHub to Expand Smart EV Charging Programs
text:
Skip to content
Rivian owners are getting an easier path into utility charging incentives thanks to a new partnership with EnergyHub, and this is one of those behind the scenes updates that quietly improves ownership over time.
The partnership brings EnergyHub’s managed charging platform directly into the Rivian ecosystem, allowing vehicles to participate in utility EV programs across North America. In practice, this means Rivians can automatically shift charging to off peak hours or respond to local grid conditions, helping utilities balance demand while potentially lowering charging costs for drivers through rebates or incentives.
Nothing about this should feel complicated for owners. The goal is simple smart charging that works in the background. Plug in like normal, and the vehicle coordinates charging in a way that benefits both the driver and the grid without extra effort.
This also reinforces how Rivian continues to position its vehicles as connected energy devices rather than just EVs. As more drivers go electric, managed charging becomes essential infrastructure, and partnerships like this help turn every parked Rivian into part of a smarter, more resilient energy network.
